news.title: Google updates Workspace to make AI your new office intern
news.description: Google has introduced a host of new automated functions into Workspace, all of which are driven by Workspace Intelligence, its new AI system.

news.title: Hands on with X’s new AI-powered custom feeds
news.description: X's AI-powered custom timelines are replacing Communities, with Grok-curated feeds...and new ad slots.

news.title: How SpaceX preempted a $2B fundraise with a $60B buyout offer
news.description: Cursor was on track to close a $2 billion funding round this week but chose to halt discussions after SpaceX offered a $10 billion "collaboration fee" and a path to a $60 billion acquisition.

news.title: Google Cloud launches two new AI chips to compete with Nvidia
news.description: Google's newest TPUs are faster and cheaper than the previous versions. But the company is still embracing Nvidia in its cloud — for now.

news.title: AI is flattening the jobs market for young people, says Sunak
news.description: The former prime minister said graduates' concerns about getting entry-level jobs are justified.

news.title: Anthropic investigating claim of unauthorised access to Mythos AI tool
news.description: The AI company has said the model is too dangerous to release publicly because of its hacking capabilities.

news.title: UK gaming icon Peter Molyneux on AI, his final creation and a changing industry
news.description: The creator of iconic series such as Fable says Masters of Albion will be the last game he makes.

news.title: Meta to track workers' clicks and keystrokes to train AI
news.description: The firm will take data from the way employees work for its artificial intelligence models.
